environment.description: Node.js Express application deployed as an AWS Lambda function with a Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function runs in a VPC with connectivity to the corporate LDAP directory (internal-directory.corp.local:389). No API Gateway or ALB in front. The function URL is publicly accessible at https://<url-id>.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. No input validation middleware or WAF is attached.
